candidates.angle: Krishna calls those who fix their mind on Him with supreme trust the highest yogis
candidates.evidence: मय्यावेश्य मनो ... ते मे युक्ततमा मताः (placing their mind in me ... they are considered the highest yogis by me)

candidates.angle: Nityayuktah means always united, and it shows steady focus
Parayopeta means endowed with the highest, and it points to supreme trust

angle_en: Highest yogis are those who fix their mind on Him
angle_hi: सर्वश्रेष्ठ योगी वे हैं जो अपना मन मुझमें लगाते हैं

en.intro: Krishna answers by naming the highest yogis, and He defines them by their steady focus and complete trust.
en.notice: Krishna calls those who fix their mind on Him with supreme trust the highest yogis, and He uses the word nityayuktah, always united, to show that steady focus is the mark of the best.
en.next: Krishna then names those who worship the unmanifest, the eternal, and the imperishable, restraining the senses to reach Him alone.
en.meaning: Those who focus their mind on me, worship me with unwavering devotion, and are filled with supreme trust are, in my view, the highest yogis.

hi.intro: कृष्ण फिर सर्वश्रेष्ठ योगियों की पहचान बताते हैं, और उन्हें उनके स्थिर ध्यान और पूर्ण श्रद्धा से परिभाषित करते हैं।
hi.notice: कृष्ण उन लोगों को सर्वश्रेष्ठ योगी कहते हैं जो पूरी श्रद्धा से मेरा ध्यान लगाते हैं, और वे नित्ययुक्ताः, यानी हमेशा लगे रहने वाले, शब्द का प्रयोग करते हैं जो स्थिर ध्यान को दर्शाता है।
hi.next: कृष्ण फिर उन लोगों का वर्णन करते हैं जो अचल, शाश्वत और अविनाशी का ध्यान करते हैं।
hi.meaning: श्री भगवान कहते हैं, जो मेरेमें मन को लगाकर नित्यनिरन्तर मेरेमें लगे हुए भक्त परम श्रद्धासे युक्त होकर मेरी उपासना करते हैं, वे मेरे मतमें सर्वश्रेष्ठ योगी हैं ॥

en.intro: Krishna answers by naming the highest yogis, and He defines them by their steady focus and complete trust.
en.body: Those who focus their mind on me, worship me with unwavering devotion, and are filled with supreme trust are, in my view, the highest yogis. Krishna calls those who fix their mind on Him with supreme trust the highest yogis, and He uses the word nityayuktah, always united, to show that steady focus is the mark of the best.
